description: Classification of all 2438 SDE checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 40 SDE guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement — tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance — tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

additionalRequirementTypes.material-specification: Construction material type must be verified
